The place of one character in a GlyphLayout, with the font, the face and the style it draws with.

|---|---|---|

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `int` | [getIndex](#GlyphPlacement-method-getIndex)() | Returns the index of the character in the string, markup tags included. |
| `int` | [getCodepoint](#GlyphPlacement-method-getCodepoint)() | Returns the character. |
